TO: Oversight Committee Republican Members
FROM: Oversight Committee Republican Staff
DATE: November 16, 2025
RE: Oversight Committee Democrats Push Anti-Trump Hoax Instead of Pursuing Justice for Epstein Victims

I. Overview

The House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform is conducting a thorough review of the federal
government’s investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell to ensure accountability and
transparency for the American people and the survivors of their horrific crimes.

Unfortunately, during this investigation, Oversight Committee Democrats, led by Ranking Member Robert
Garcia (D-Calif.), have intentionally mischaracterized witness testimony and selectively released information
with targeted redactions in an effort to create another hoax involving President Trump. When the Majority
released the full set of documents, Democrats claimed that this transparency was meant to “disorient” and
“distract” from the false narrative they had been attempting to construct about President Trump.

After whipping their Democrat base into a frenzy with absurd promises of finally “getting” President Trump,
Committee Democrats have now turned to concocting narratives from out-of-context documents, salacious
innuendo, and outright lies regarding testimony and the evidentiary record to distract the American people from
their own lack of ideas and leadership.

The Democrats have uncovered nothing new, have released no document not provided at the request of
Republicans, and have only succeeded in reinforcing what the American people already knew: President Trump
knew Jeffrey Epstein decades ago, President Trump ended the relationship with Epstein, and President Trump
did not participate or know about the nature of Epstein’s evil.

Committee Democrats have overpromised and underdelivered, and now they paw through every new document
production looking for a single term: Trump. The problem for the Democrats is that there is just nothing here.
Like Russiagate, the Steele Dossier, and phony prosecutions before it, the Democrats will devise or amplify any
conspiratorial mirage before engaging President Trump in a conversation about how to better the lives of the
American people.

This memorandum outlines the Democrats’ actions and demonstrates how they appear more focused on
advancing an anti-Trump narrative than on pursuing justice for Epstein’s victims.

II. Background

On July 23, 2025, Chairman James Comer (R-Ky.) issued a subpoena to Ghislaine Maxwell for a deposition. On
August 5, 2025, Chairman Comer issued deposition subpoenas to Bill and Hillary Clinton, former FBI
Directors, and former U.S. Attorneys General for testimony related to horrific crimes perpetrated by
Jeffrey Epstein. Additionally, Chairman Comer issued a subpoena to the U.S. Department of Justice for records
related to Epstein.

On August 25, 2025, Chairman Comer issued a subpoena to the Epstein estate for documents and
communications in its possession, custody, or control in unredacted form, and announced that
Alexander Acosta, former U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Florida and former Secretary of the U.S.
Department of Labor, would appear voluntarily for a transcribed interview on September 19, 2025.
